title: The Real Effects of Shadow Banking: Evidence from China
near_miss_reason: Entropy-balancing weights in every column: all Table 3-9 regressions use [aw=ebw], firm-year weights that balance borrowers and non-borrowers on time-varying firm characteristics (ebw varies within firm for 107,908 control firms; borrowers = 1). This is treated as a propensity-type reweighting estimator under PROTOCOL 5b (IPW is not eligible). Table 3 columns 1-3 are otherwise clean TWFE (firm + year FE, no controls, clustered by firm). Columns 4-6 and Tables 4, 6-9 add time-varying controls; Table 5 is IV. JUDGMENT CALL: if the lead treats entropy-balancing weights as plain analysis weights, Table 3 columns 1-3 become 3 eligible specifications on shipped real data.
eligible_reason: Staggered binary design: ASIF firm-year panel 2005-2013 with ELperiod = 1 while a firm has an outstanding entrusted loan; in the regression sample 75 firms first borrow in 2005 (5), 2006 (6), 2007 (6), 2008 (11), 2011 (15), 2012 (22) or 2013 (10), and 108,552 never-borrowers serve as controls; firm and year FE. Treatment switches off for 43 firms (drop post-adoption zeros under the switch-off rule); 9 firms are treated in their first observed year. Every column is entropy-balance weighted.
design_notes: FinalData.dta (1,412,665 rows, 50 vars; ASIF + SIPO patents + CSMAR lender data). Table 3 (lines 86-96): bs1-bs3 reghdfe {lninnovation2y, lnTcite2y, lnPatExplore2y} ELperiod [aw=ebw], absorb(IDID year) vce(cl IDID); bs4-bs6 add controls (lnasset2 leverage lnage PPE_staff ROA currentratio sales_growth HHI HHI2 SOE). Table 4: debt-change controls, city x year and industry x year FE, lagged patent stock. Table 5: xtivreg2 with lender housing-purchase restriction IV. Tables 6-8: ELperiod x loan/lender characteristics. Table 9: lender-side panel (Lenderside.dta) with controls. Figure 2: 1,000 random placebo assignments (the `controls' local is undefined at that point, so no controls). Published T3.txt: 0.179** (0.07), 0.142** (0.07), 0.124*** (0.04), N = 581,810.
n_eligible_specs_note: 0 under the entropy-balancing = IPW reading; 3 (Table 3 cols 1-3) if entropy-balancing weights are admitted as analysis weights.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: First ELperiod years in the regression sample (rows with ebw and outcome non-missing): 2005:5, 2006:6, 2007:6, 2008:11, 2011:15, 2012:22, 2013:10 (88 haveEL firms in the sample, 75 with an ELperiod=1 row). 45 switch-off transitions among 43 firms.
